If you’re honest about your situation (e.g., "We’re keeping things simple this year due to tight finances"), **no one will judge you**. Cost: $5-$15. | Shows participation without strain. It’s an honor to be here with all of you." **Note:** No one will ask. If they do, they’re not part of a true community — and you’d be doing * them* a favor by not overextending yourself. --- ### ❤️ **Final Thought:** Community isn’t about who brings the most food — it’s about ** showing up with an open heart**.
